parameter_matrix.note: A part wins only if its operating Vin range strictly encompasses the counterpart on both ends.
Higher Vin,abs improves survivability against hot-plug and inductive bus spikes.
Tighter Vout tolerance improves ADC reference and digital rail margin.
Actual usable continuous Iout is also bounded by package θJA thermal derating.
Lower Iq directly extends sleep-mode battery life in always-on IoT/portable rails.
Lower dropout allows regulation deeper into Li-ion / 3.7 V discharge curves.

parameter_matrix.part_a_value: Ceramic OK · >=1 µF · Low-ESR MLCC compatible
parameter_matrix.note: Non-ceramic-stable LDOs oscillate with low-ESR MLCCs unless series resistance or tantalum is used.
Higher PSRR attenuates upstream switching-converter ripple on analog/RF rails.
Critical for RF VCOs, low-noise ADCs, and precision sensor excitation.
Lower θJA yields lower junction temperature rise ΔTj = (Vin - Vout) × Iout × θJA.
Keep steady-state Tj at least 15–25 °C below Tj,max for production reliability.

swap_risks: HIGH LOAD CURRENT DERATING: TLV70033DDCR supplies up to 200 mA (p.5) compared to AP2112K-3.3TRG1 at 600 mA (p.8); confirm peak inrush and thermal dissipation margin.
HIGH THERMAL MARGIN: Package θJA is 28% higher on TLV70033DDCR (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: 184 °C/W p.3 vs TLV70033DDCR: 235.9 °C/W p.5); re-check Tj = Ta + Pd × θJA against Tj,max.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 requires Vin,min >= 2.5 V (p.3) vs 2 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.

HIGH TEMPERATURE GRADE MISMATCH: Rated ambient range differs (AP2112K-3.3TRG1: -40..85 °C Industrial (-40°C to +85°C) vs TLV70033DDCR: -40..125 °C Extended Industrial (-40°C to +125°C TJ)); AP2112K-3.3TRG1 hot limit only 85 °C — verify product ambient qualification before swapping.
engineering_verdict: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (Diodes Incorporated, SOT-23-5) and TLV70033DDCR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are Level 2 Functional / Tuning Required alternatives: the PCB land pattern is compatible, but passive retuning or rating derating is mandatory because Iout,max rating drops >=20%; θJA worsens 28% (thermal derating verification required); Vin,min floor rises 0.5 V. Under a representative 5 V → 3.3 V rail at 150 mA (255 mW), estimated self-heating is ΔTj ≈ 46.9 °C on AP2112K-3.3TRG1 (θJA 184 °C/W) vs 60.2 °C on TLV70033DDCR (θJA 235.9 °C/W), while quiescent draw spans a 1.8x ratio (55 µA (p.8) vs 31 µA (p.6)). Primary bench gotchas to watch: AP2112K-3.3TRG1 "6.5 V Abs Max & SOT25 Thermal Limit at 600 mA From 5 V Input" (p.3) and TLV70033DDCR "VEN Must Never Exceed VIN + 0.3 V (Sequencing Trap vs TPS7A02/TLV755P)" (p.5). BOM decision: Choose AP2112K-3.3TRG1 when load current exceeds 200 mA (up to 600 mA) or lower package θJA (184 °C/W) is needed for thermal margin; choose TLV70033DDCR when battery sleep budget demands 31 µA Iq. Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.1 vs TOP_VIEW p.4) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
